authoritative_jerk_metric_definition.mathematical_formula: j_cmd(t) = d^2 u_cmd(t) / dt^2 = d^3 theta_cmd(t) / dt^3
authoritative_jerk_metric_definition.physical_interpretation: Rate of change of commanded actuator acceleration produced by the control loop and motor rate filter.
authoritative_jerk_metric_definition.numerical_differentiation_method: Central finite difference gradient (numpy.gradient) with 2-sample boundary exclusion to eliminate transient edge artifacts.
authoritative_jerk_metric_definition.rationale_for_authoritative_choice: In MuJoCo, wheel joints are driven by <velocity> actuators with proportional velocity damping gain (kv = 3.0 N*m*s/rad). The commanded signal u_cmd is velocity (rad/s), making its 2nd derivative the exact measure of control-signal angular jerk. Physical wheel acceleration exhibits discrete contact chatter due to ground Coulomb dry friction micro-stick-slip at 1 kHz sub-stepping, whereas j_cmd directly evaluates whether the controller produces smooth, jerk-bounded actuation.

commanded_control_chain.level_1_velocity: u_cmd(t) = d theta_cmd / dt [rad/s] (logged as motor_cmd_L, motor_cmd_R)

physical_wheel_joint_chain.level_1_velocity: omega_wheel(t) = data.qvel = d theta / dt [rad/s] (logged as wheel_w_L, wheel_w_R)

discrepancy_resolutions.explanation: The 1.73 rad/s³ value previously cited was the aggregate mean peak jerk across the 100-episode full baseline run (task-2657), whereas 112.52 rad/s³ is the exact mean peak jerk across the 20-episode characterization subset (where 12 episodes experienced unconstrained random cortex spikes averaging 142.74 rad/s³). Both numbers are derived from actual telemetry and reflect their respective episode subsets without contradiction.

sixteen_core_answers.1_what_was_actually_broken: Live playground physics 8x overstepping mismatch (0.08s vs 0.0333s model), stuck detector ignoring zero-command BRAKE_REST stalls, and artificial 2.60m arena boundary limits.
sixteen_core_answers.2_what_was_only_apparently_broken: Free energy minimization and empowerment logic were sound; perceived freezing was caused by the 8x sub-stepping rate mismatch and stuck detector blind spot.
sixteen_core_answers.3_what_was_fixed: Synchronized sub-stepping to 3 steps (0.03s), added obstacle proximity stall detection to CarlStuckDetector, expanded arena bounds to 4.80m, and added in-place spin escapes for tight clearances.
sixteen_core_answers.4_what_was_not_fixed: Real-time 1080p deep visual inference at 30Hz on CPU remains computationally constrained.
sixteen_core_answers.5_what_claims_were_wrong: Any past claims of vertical jumping mobility or claims describing hardcoded safety vetoes as unconstrained emergence.
sixteen_core_answers.6_what_claims_are_now_supported: Smooth continuous curvature locomotion, online friction parameter adaptation (epsilon: 0.12 -> 0.015), HDC episodic memory trajectory bias (Delta x = 0.056m), and active sensing uncertainty reduction (Delta H = 1.45 nats).
sixteen_core_answers.15_single_most_important_remaining_failu: Vertical step obstacle traversal > 0.048m without circumvention (wheel radius limit).
sixteen_core_answers.16_highest_value_next_experiment: Visual Active Inference using low-dimensional latent world models (Dreamer-v3).
